title: Reactome (CC-BY) cancer-pathway membership track
context: Reactome is a CC-BY 4.0-licensed, peer-reviewed pathway database mapping genes to biological processes, including cancer-relevant signalling and metabolic pathways. Mapping Reactome pathway membership to gene coordinates on the genome provides researchers and educators with a contextual overlay — e.g. which driver genes sit in the same pathway — that is not available from variant tracks alone. This is a Priority-A source with clear redistribution terms; attribution of the CC-BY license in the manifest and track metadata is required.
objective: Build the Reactome cancer-pathway membership track pack on hg38, emitting all three browser targets, with CC-BY 4.0 attribution captured in the manifest and embedded in track metadata, and per-feature provenance to Reactome pathway IDs.
acceptanceCriteria: Source is Reactome (CC-BY 4.0); licensegate-002 PASS artifact committed with permitsRedistribution: true and attribution captured; CC-BY attribution string is embedded in the track description and manifest.
Pathway-membership features are mapped to gene coordinates on hg38; coordgate-003 PASS artifact committed.
All three browser targets emitted (UCSC + JBrowse 2 + IGV) and render-verified; cancer-pathway gene features appear at expected loci on hg38 with evidence in outcomes/pack-016.json.
Per-feature provenance records Reactome pathway IDs, source release version, and CC-BY license; provenance completeness score ≥ 90/100.
Pack carries not-medical-advice notice; hosted at a loadable URL; adoption evidence or blocker recorded.
output: output/packs/reactome-pathways-hg38/ — track files, browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/pack-016.json.
